name: Maszat
description: I had a thought that we should have a multi-day summer festival at home for the furry audience. I am working on what is necessary for this and helping with the organization so that everyone can have a good time at the event!

name: Bethlenke
description: Hello everyone! I am Bethlenke. I am one of the team members responsible for the sound and technical aspects of the event to ensure the best atmosphere at the party. :D

name: Northern
description: Hello everyone! I will make the event colorful and bright. My job is to implement and operate mood lights at the event, handle the electronic part of the suit dryers, and prepare weather forecasts for the duration of the event.
